reviewMethod: AI-assisted visual scope screening; not expert-validated botanical labels
notes: AI-assisted visual scope screening of all 1000 collected candidates on 20 numbered sheets, with 17 full-size checks; 995 retained and 5 excluded for uncertain species/scope or an unidentifiable dark/texture image. No model predictions were viewed or used in selection. User confirmed no use for training, threshold tuning, temperature fitting or checkpoint selection. All supplied byte/decoded/perceptual identities matched; no exact or phash-distance<=5 matches against 5160 supplied training-manifest photos. Publisher author profiles are recorded where available, but historical source/capture provenance is unknown and full independence is not proven. This is AI-assisted screening, not expert-validated botanical ground truth or field accuracy evidence.
